description: This source file declares the SharedFdGatekeeperChannel class, which implements an interface for communication channels that send Gatekeeper IPC/RPC messages over shared file descriptors. It provides methods for sending requests and responses and receiving messages, encapsulating a shared file descriptor based transport channel.

classes.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
classes.description: A class implementing GatekeeperChannel interface that uses shared file descriptors for synchronous IPC/RPC communication.

methods.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shared file descriptors used for communication.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message over the shared file descriptor channel.
